messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: loglikelihood discrepancy from multiple regression
parts:
On 12/24/2015 02:56 PM, KwonHyun Kim wrote:
>
> I am using Mplus examples to testing lavaan
>
> and I got different loglikelihood, aic, bic, etc. for example 3.1
>
> basically everything else is the same.
>
> What's wrong?

Nothing. Mplus ignores the 'fixed-x' covariates when computing the
loglikelihood; lavaan (0.5-20) includes the covariates. This explains
the difference.

To get the same likelihood: add the variances of the x-covariates to the
syntax in Mplus.

Yves.
